claims.subject: alhammarret

evidence.quote: He’d spent two years as the sphinx’s apprentice, learning the full abilities
Even purely out of self-interest, Alhammarret had to covet a planeswalker apprentice.

claims.summary: The sphinx Alhammarret took the young Jace Beleren as his apprentice for two years (Jace's past, on Vryn).
claims.limitation: The apprentice sentence names 'the sphinx'; the sphinx is identified as Alhammarret by the neighbouring sentence.

claims.subject: eldrazi_titans

evidence.quote: Six thousand years ago, three Planeswalkers lured the three Eldrazi titans—horrific, world-devouring entities—to Zendikar, and trapped them there.

claims.summary: In the past, three Planeswalkers lured the three Eldrazi titans to Zendikar and trapped them there.
claims.limitation: Primer page; the three Planeswalkers are not named in this sentence.

claims.subject: rakdos

evidence.quote: Rakdos, aligned with black and red mana, is an endless carnival of depraved revelry. Their leader is an ancient demon named Rakdos

claims.summary: The demon Rakdos leads the Rakdos guild (Magic Origins primer, 2015).
claims.limitation: 'Rakdos' in the first sentence names the guild; 'Their leader' refers back to it.

claims.subject: meren

evidence.quote: You are Meren, shaman apprentice of the Nel Toth.

claims.summary: Meren is a shaman apprentice of Clan Nel Toth on Jund.

claims.subject: kael

evidence.quote: She scanned the familiar faces of the Circle, finding her master, Kael, sitting tall and proud, watching closely.

claims.summary: Kael is Meren's master in the Circle of Nel Toth.
claims.limitation: Point-of-view narration; 'She' is the viewpoint character Meren.

claims.subject: lazav

evidence.quote: Lazav the Mastermind, Guildmaster of House Dimir?

claims.summary: Lazav is Guildmaster of House Dimir (Guilds of Ravnica, 2018).
claims.limitation: Spoken as a question by a character recognising him.

claims.subject: vraska

evidence.quote: Vraska, our guildmaster, is worried the Boros will use this as another excuse to infiltrate the undercity

claims.summary: Vraska is guildmaster of the Golgari (Guilds of Ravnica, 2018).
claims.limitation: First-person Golgari narrator; the guild is identified by context (the undercity, 'the Golgari guildhall'), not named in the quote.

claims.subject: zegana

evidence.quote: She looks so much like Utopian Speaker Zegana—a younger, more petulant version of our leader
Perhaps it is a good thing knowing that our Combine is not fragile enough

claims.summary: Utopian Speaker Zegana leads the Simic Combine (Ravnica Allegiance, 2019).
claims.limitation: First-person Simic narrator; 'our leader' and 'our Combine' are the narrator's guild.
